## Observations

### Shared installer payload sinorag.7z holds sinorag.exe 0.5.0, not the 0.5.5 source

`verified` · `@sinorag.intake.shared-payload-stale/2` · scope `path "gui-installer/sinorag-installer-pdf-intake/**"`, `path "gui-installer/sinorag-installer-winsafe/**"`, `path "gui-installer/sinorag-installer/sinorag.7z"`

gui-installer/sinorag-installer/sinorag.7z (21,131,926 bytes, committed unchanged in 381c39f) unpacks to a sinorag.exe built 2026-05-28 that reports `sinorag 0.5.0`; Cargo.toml is at 0.5.5. That exe has no text_profile support: over indexes built by the document intake (text_profile = "words") the phrases "COOLANT Pump" and "heron colony" return 0 hits and the fragment "pum" returns 1, where a 0.5.5 release build returns 1, 1 and 0. The Freya and winsafe CBETA installers embed this payload and read their expected version from Cargo.toml, so they re-extract it on every run. The document intake embeds its own gui-installer/sinorag-installer-pdf-intake/sinorag.7z (0.5.5, packed by make-payload.ps1) instead.

**supersedes** `@sinorag.intake.shared-payload-stale/1`
